system.description:
Select one religion when purchasing the kit. It contains mundane symbols, garments, cords and accessories typical of that tradition. When using Conceal Faith to impersonate a member of that religion, you gain a +1-item bonus. It provides no actual theological knowledge; Chapter 4's normal provision for Religion, Culture or Lore checks still applies.

Rename the roll for its religion.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

goodsConditionals.label: impersonating the roll's religion
goodsConditionals.scope: Conceal Faith to impersonate a member of the roll's religion
